{-# LANGUAGE ImportQualifiedPost #-}
import Data.KindID.V7 qualified as KindID
import Data.UUID qualified as UUID
import Data.Text qualified
import Kioku.Id qualified as Id
import Shikigami.Sink.Coordinate (parseSinkSession)
main :: IO ()
main = mapM_ probe [("v4", UUID.fromWords 0 0x4000 0x80000000 1), ("wrong-variant", UUID.fromWords 0 0x7000 0 1)]
  where
    probe (label, uuid) =
      let raw = KindID.toText (KindID.decorateKindID uuid :: Id.SessionId)
       in print (label, raw, either (const False) (const True) (Id.parseId raw :: Either Data.Text.Text Id.SessionId), either (const False) (const True) (parseSinkSession raw))
